main_issue: How to adapt the weeknight dinner rota when Agent D must eat vegetarian (no shared meat pots) for a month: D cooks own food on others' nights vs. everyone cooking shared vegetarian meals.

A-B.evidence: A insisted on eating the same meal (T7, T9, T13); B said 'as long as we all eat at 6.30' (T10) and proposed D cook own food (T20); A conceded 'If that's what everyone wants' (T23).

A-C.evidence: C refused to cook two meals (T5) and backed D cooking own food (T21); A reluctantly went along (T23) after earlier objecting to separate meals.

A-D.evidence: A objected that separate cooking isn't sharing (T7, T9, T13); D offered recipes (T19) and one shared night; A finally said 'Okay. If that's what everyone wants' (T23), D agreed to own food (T22).

B-C.evidence: B's constraint of eating at 6.30 and not cooking two meals aligned with C (T4, T5); C: 'I agree with Agent B' (T21).

B-D.evidence: B proposed D cook own food as D originally said (T20); D accepted 'that's fine' (T22); B was fine with eating together at 6.30 (T10).

C-D.evidence: C refused two meals (T5), D offered own pot (T6), later D proposed shared night (T8) but accepted own-food plan C endorsed (T21-22).
